# FlyThe BG

> FlyThe BG is an independent, privacy-focused web toolkit for practical image and video work: protected AI background removal, browser-local image compression, browser-local video compression, and a passport, visa and ID photo sheet maker.

FlyThe BG does not require an account for its core tools. Image and video compression are designed to run locally in the browser. Background removal uses the protected FlyThe BG API route and the private AI credential stays server-side. The passport photo maker combines crop selection, optional background removal, physical photo dimensions, background choices, paper sizing and printable sheet generation.

## Core tools

- [Remove Background](https://flythebg.com/remove-bg): Remove backgrounds from PNG, JPG and WEBP images through the protected AI processing route.
- [Image Compressor](https://flythebg.com/image-compressor): Compress images locally in the browser and create a smaller JPEG delivery copy.
- [Video Compressor](https://flythebg.com/video-compressor): Process video locally in the browser and create a smaller WebM output when browser support permits.
- [Passport Size Visa Photo Maker](https://flythebg.com/passport-photo): Crop a photo, keep or remove its background, choose physical dimensions and paper, and generate a printable sheet.
- [All Tools](https://flythebg.com/features): Compare the available FlyThe BG workflows.

## Practical guides

- [Blogs](https://flythebg.com/blogs): First-party guides covering media formats, compression, privacy and practical workflows.
- [Remove Background Online: Privacy Guide](https://flythebg.com/blogs/remove-background-online-privacy): What can happen to an image during online background removal and what privacy questions to ask.
- [How to Compress Images in Your Browser](https://flythebg.com/blogs/compress-images-in-browser): Browser-local compression, dimensions, quality and file-size trade-offs.
- [WebM Video Compression Guide](https://flythebg.com/blogs/webm-video-compression-guide): Codecs, WebM, browser support and video file size.
- [Passport Photo Sizes](https://flythebg.com/blogs/passport-photo-size-guide): Centimetres, inches, pixels and physical photo dimensions.
- [Passport Photo Printing Guide](https://flythebg.com/blogs/passport-photo-printing-guide): A4 and other paper sizes, layout and print scaling.
- [PNG vs JPG](https://flythebg.com/blogs/png-vs-jpg-guide): Choosing formats for transparency, photos, graphics and delivery.
- [Image File Size Guide](https://flythebg.com/blogs/image-file-size-guide): Practical ways to reduce image size while preserving useful quality.
- [Transparent Backgrounds](https://flythebg.com/blogs/transparent-background-guide): Alpha transparency, PNG and common use cases.
- [Social Media Image Sizes](https://flythebg.com/blogs/social-media-image-sizes): A practical workflow for dimensions and file size.
- [Email Image Sizes](https://flythebg.com/blogs/email-image-size-guide): Image dimensions, attachments and loading considerations.
- [Website Image Optimization](https://flythebg.com/blogs/website-image-optimization): Dimensions, compression, formats and browser delivery.
- [Why Video Files Get So Large](https://flythebg.com/blogs/video-file-size-guide): Resolution, bitrate, duration, codec and frame rate.
- [Browser Media Privacy](https://flythebg.com/blogs/browser-media-privacy): What browser-local processing means for device privacy.
- [WebP vs JPG](https://flythebg.com/blogs/webp-vs-jpg-guide): Quality, size, compatibility and transparency trade-offs.
- [How to Choose an Image Format](https://flythebg.com/blogs/how-to-choose-image-format): A practical format decision guide.
